cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.19)
project(v8_configuration_probe CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(USE_SE_V8 ON)
include("${ENGINE_PATH}/native/external/win64/CMakeLists.txt")
file(GLOB V8_DLLS "${ENGINE_PATH}/native/external/win64/libs/v8/release/*.dll")
set(CC_EXECUTABLE_NAME v8-configuration-probe)
set(CC_PROJECT_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/native")
add_executable(${CC_EXECUTABLE_NAME} main.cpp common/Classes/Game.cpp)
target_link_libraries(${CC_EXECUTABLE_NAME} PRIVATE v8)
target_compile_definitions(${CC_EXECUTABLE_NAME} PRIVATE "$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:CC_DEBUG=1>")
include("${PLUGIN_DEV_CMAKE}")
